description.value: The Rossland Museum & Discovery Centre chronicles the history of Rossland from its gold-mining origins through its evolution into a celebrated ski town in the Kootenays. It also houses the Rossland Visitor Centre, making it a natural first stop for touring cyclists arriving in the area. A major renewal project — The Mine Experience — is underway, with over $5M raised toward an expanded underground mine exhibit.
